claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.options[].fixedChargeCost
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cure-poison mode always costs exactly 5 charges from the pool, regardless of player choice. The current surface has no way to express a fixed per-option charge cost within a CastTimeEffectModeChoice. Without it, the trace shows remove_condition as a freely choosable mode branch with no cost constraint, which is misleading — the RAW cost is 5, not variable.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.
